info.title: FlowForge API
info.description: Multi-tenant durable workflow platform. Tenant endpoints use the `x-api-key` header; every tenant request counts against its per-minute rate limit. Request bodies are limited to 100 KiB and 64 levels of JSON nesting; unknown properties of request bodies are ignored.

200.description: The execution and its step runs.

Server-sent events. `snapshot` carries the full `ExecutionDetail` on connect and after every change; the stream closes after a final status. `gone` is sent when the execution disappears. A comment is sent every 15 s; `retry: 3000` asks clients to reconnect after 3 s.

get.description: At most EXECUTION_STREAMS_PER_TENANT open streams per tenant and API instance.

post.description: Standard Webhooks signature: `webhook-signature: v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256(secret, webhook-id + "." + webhook-timestamp + "." + raw body)>`, several space-separated signatures allowed. The timestamp must be within WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS of the server time. Every redelivery with the same `webhook-id` returns the existing execution. An unknown or disabled workflow and a bad signature get the same 401. Compressed bodies are refused, because the signature covers the bytes as they arrive.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: Unique id of the event, 1 to 256 visible ASCII characters; redeliveries reuse it.

schema.description: Becomes the input of the execution.

415.description: The body is not application/json, or it is compressed (`Content-Encoding`); the signature is checked over the bytes as they arrive.

get.description: Shows notifications that are still pending or were given up (`dead`), with the last error, so a tenant can see why its endpoint received nothing. The payload is not returned.

post.summary: Notification sent to the tenant endpoint when an execution finishes
post.description: Recorded in the same transaction as the final status (transactional outbox) and delivered at least once with retries; deduplicate by `webhook-id`, which stays the same for every attempt. Signed like inbound webhooks, with each active outbound secret.

2XX.description: Delivered. Any other answer or a timeout is retried with exponential backoff up to OUTBOX_MAX_ATTEMPTS.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Tenant API key returned once by POST /tenants.

message.description: Validation errors are returned as a list, one message per problem.

Error.description: Every error has this shape. Unexpected errors are answered with 500 and the message "Internal server error"; details are only logged, with the request id.

id.description: Unique within the workflow; later steps read the output as `steps.<id>`.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL with a fixed origin. Placeholders such as `{{ input.orderId }}` are allowed only in the path, query or fragment and are percent-encoded. Internal, private and cloud metadata addresses are refused when the step runs, including after redirects and DNS answers.

headers.description: Host, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, Connection, Keep-Alive, Upgrade and Expect cannot be set. Idempotency-Key and X-Correlation-Id are always set by the platform.

body.description: Template. Values are encoded for the body format: inside a JSON string they are escaped, in a JSON value position they become JSON values, in a form body they are percent-encoded.

id.description: Unique within the workflow; later steps read the output as `steps.<id>`.

expr.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in an isolated QuickJS sandbox with `ctx = { input, steps }`; limited in time, memory and stack, without access to the host.

id.description: Unique within the workflow; later steps read the output as `steps.<id>`.
Unique within the workflow; later steps read the output as `steps.<id>`.

ms.description: Durable timer: the job is parked until the wake-up time and does not hold a worker slot.

MissedRunPolicy.description: What to do with runs missed while no scheduler was running: drop them, run the latest once, or run each of them (at most SCHEDULER_MAX_CATCH_UP_RUNS).

Cron.description: Five fields, or six with seconds; runs must be at least one minute apart. Evaluated in `timezone`, including daylight saving time changes. `null` removes the schedule.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Kyiv.

UpdateWorkflow.description: Changing `steps` creates a new version. Running executions keep the version they started with.

nextRunAt.description: Next scheduled run, `null` without a schedule or while disabled.

ExecutionStatus.description: `pending`: queued or waiting for a retry; `waiting`: parked by a delay step; `succeeded` and `failed` are final.

workflowVersion.description: The version snapshot this execution runs.

output.description: Output of the last step once the execution succeeded.

triggerKey.description: `webhook:<workflowId>:<webhook-id>` or `cron:<workflowId>:<scheduled time>`; unique per tenant, so a redelivered webhook or a second scheduler never creates a second execution.

correlationId.description: Request id of the trigger; passed to every step, outgoing request and notification.

idempotencyKey.description: `<executionId>:<stepId>` for http steps, the same for every attempt.

output.description: Checkpoint: a succeeded step is never run again.

wakeAt.description: Wake-up time of a delay step.

apiKey.description: Shown only once; only its hash is stored.

webhookSecret.description: Inbound webhook signing secret `whsec_<base64>`, shown only once.

TenantLimits.description: `null` means the platform default from the configuration.

expiresAt.description: End of the grace period of a rotated secret; `null` for the current one.

executionId.description: The same id for every redelivery of the same `webhook-id`.

url.description: http or https, without credentials or fragment. The address is checked against the SSRF rules on every delivery.

secret.description: Returned by a PUT when the tenant has no active outbound signing secret yet (usually the first one), which then creates it. Shown only once.

nextRunAt.description: Next scheduled run, `null` without a schedule or while disabled.

WorkflowSummary.description: A workflow as it appears in lists, without its steps; read one workflow for its steps.

workflowVersion.description: The version snapshot this execution runs.

triggerKey.description: `webhook:<workflowId>:<webhook-id>` or `cron:<workflowId>:<scheduled time>`; unique per tenant, so a redelivered webhook or a second scheduler never creates a second execution.

correlationId.description: Request id of the trigger; passed to every step, outgoing request and notification.

ExecutionSummary.description: An execution as it appears in lists, without its input and output; read one execution for them.

id.description: Sent as `webhook-id`; the same on every attempt.

Unauthorized.description: The credentials are missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The admin token is missing or wrong; the body is not looked at.

NotFound.description: Not found, or it belongs to another tenant.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than 100 KiB.

TooManyRequests.description: A tenant limit is reached: requests per minute, queued jobs or open streams.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The API is shutting down; reconnect to another instance.

RequestId.description: Correlation id of the request: the `x-request-id` sent by the client when it matches `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`, a new UUID otherwise.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for the tenant.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time in seconds when the window resets.

NextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.

RequestId.name: x-request-id
RequestId.description: Optional correlation id; echoed in the response and stored on the execution.
